Hey, I'm Kaya.

You probably know me as OKSoft, which is a name I've been using since 2017 to publish games my friends and I make.

I have a little youtube channel for all my trailers, devlogs, and various bits and bobs. The above linked video is a 13 minute rundown of good racing games that are out and about now, as well as a little tease of what I have cooking right now. Feel free to subscribe, and like, and all that.

notes.title: Nebula's Descent OUT NOW
notes.content:
It took a while, but here's the latest from OKSoft: Nebula's Descent.

It's a score-based arcadey roguelike dungeon crawler. I would suggest you buy it and try to beat my score. We've achievements, original music, and fun gameplay. It's pretty cheap.

notes.title: Major Update for Coffin Mall
notes.content:
Hi hello,

Coffin Mall's been updated with a load of good stuff, Here's a list.

[b]Content[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]A Bonus Mode has been added.[/b] It will unlock upon your first completion of the game.
[*] [b]The soundtrack has been expanded.[/b] The bonus mode has its own track.
[*] [b]Speedrun Leaderboards have been added.[/b] There's one for the main game and bonus mode, they will keep your best times. They are accessible through Steam via the achievements menu or the stats button on your list of games.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed rendering to hopefully fix a bug that totally broke the game for some GPU drivers.
[*] Added the game logo to the main menu.
[*] You can no longer finish the game by clicking the side doors.
[*] Updated credits to be complete.
[*] Took care of Odysseus.
[/list]

notes.title: Coffin Mall is OUT NOW.
notes.content:
Hey,

We released our new game Coffin Mall about an hour ago. it's a fun horror romp if you have an hour to spare, but probably will make you want to return.

I plan to come in with a few updates, adding at least one bonus mode, speedrun leaderboards and other fluff to further extend your enjoyment of this game.

[b]Here's the trailer.[/b]
